John drinks 1 glass of water with breakfast, 1 glass with lunch, and 1 glass with dinner, which totals to 3 glasses of water per day.

Let's assume Henry baked x cookies last year.
He wants to make twice as many as he did last year, so he wants to make 2x cookies.
When he finished baking, he realized he actually baked 15 more cookies than he meant to, so he baked 2x + 15 cookies.
He dropped 5 cookies, so he has 2x + 15 - 5 = 2x + 10 cookies left.
He now has a total of 110 cookies, so 2x + 10 = 110.
Subtracting 10 from both sides, we get 2x = 100.
Dividing both sides by 2, we get x = 50.
Henry baked 50 cookies last year.
FINAL: 50
